policies.backend:
<retry condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ShouldRetry", true))" count="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount", 20) )" interval="1" delta="1">
			<set-variable name="PolicyCycleCounter" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter") + 1)" />
			
			<set-variable name="listBackends" value="@{
				JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];

				backends.OfType()
					.Where(backend => backend.Value("isThrottling") && DateTime.UtcNow >= backend.Value("retryAfter"))
					.ToList()
					.ForEach(backend => {
						backend["isThrottling"] = false;
						backend["retryAfter"] = DateTime.MinValue;
					});

				return backends;
			}" />
			

			
			<set-variable name="ErrorScenario" value="@{
				// Error Scenario
				JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
				var backendIndex = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1);
				var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
				var elapsedStr = context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3");
				var counter = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter", 0);
				if ( backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) {

					if ( counter > 0 ) {
						arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", $"Invalid backend index: {backendIndex}" }});
					} else {
						var throttled = new List();
						var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

						foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
							JObject b = (JObject)backends[i];
							if (!b.Value("isThrottling")) {
								continue;
							}

							var remainingSeconds = b.Value("retryAfter") > now
								? (int)Math.Ceiling((b.Value("retryAfter") - now).TotalSeconds)
								: 0;
							var retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60);
							throttled.Add(b.Value("label") + " - " + retryAfterText);
						}

						string msg = "THROTTLED: (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")";

						arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },{ "message", msg }});
					}
					return 4; // unknown
				}

				var lastStatusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0;
				var callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", true);
				var wasLimited = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("wasLimited", false);
				var startTime = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("CallAttemptStartTime", DateTime.UtcNow);
				var deltaSeconds = (DateTime.UtcNow - startTime).TotalSeconds;
				var requestTimeout = ((JObject)backends[backendIndex]).Value("timeout");
				bool likelyTimeout = deltaSeconds >= (requestTimeout * 0.9);

				JObject backend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex];

				if ( callCompleted ) {
					if (lastStatusCode==200) {
						return 0; // success
					} else {
						return 1; // error
					}
				} else if ( likelyTimeout) {
					arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", $"Throttling [{backendIndex}] by 10s, likely timeout Elapsed: {deltaSeconds:F1}s Timeout: {requestTimeout}s" }});
					backend["isThrottling"] = true;
					backend["retryAfter"] = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(10);
					return 2; // timeout
				} else if ( wasLimited ) {
					arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", $"Throttling [{backendIndex}] by 10s due to concurrency limit" }});
					backend["isThrottling"] = true;
					backend["retryAfter"] = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(10);
					return 3; // concurrency limit
				} else {
					arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", elapsedStr },{ "message", $"Error status {lastStatusCode} after {deltaSeconds:F1}s" }});
					return 4; // unknown
				}
			}" />

			
			<set-variable name="backendIndex" value="@{
				try {

				// Retrieve the list of backends
				JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				if (!backends.Any()) {return -1;}

				JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
				int backendCallCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter", 0);
				bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contextWindowExceeded", false);
 
				// Only check backend affinity on the first call and if no context window error
				if (backendCallCount == 0 && !contextWindowExceeded) {
					int affinityBackendIdx = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequestAffinityBackendIdx", -1);

					// Check if we have a valid affinity backend and it's in our priority list
					if (affinityBackendIdx != -1 ) {
						JObject backend = (JObject)backends[affinityBackendIdx];
						// Only use the affinity backend if it's not throttling
						if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) {
							return affinityBackendIdx;
						}
					}
				}

				// If no affinity match found or not the first call, proceed with normal selection
				// Find all non-throttling backends that support the request priority
				var availableBackends = new List();
				int lowestPriority = int.MaxValue;
				
				// Find the lowest priority available backends
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					
					// Skip PTU backends if context window exceeded
					if (contextWindowExceeded && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") {
						continue;
					}
					
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) {
						int priority = backend.Value("priorityGroup");
						if (priority < lowestPriority) {
							lowestPriority = priority;
							availableBackends.Clear();
							availableBackends.Add(i);  // Store the index instead of the backend object
						} else if (priority == lowestPriority) {
							availableBackends.Add(i);  // Store the index instead of the backend object
						}
					}
				}

				if (!availableBackends.Any())  { return -1; }

				// pick a random backend from the available ones
				return availableBackends[ new Random(context.RequestId.GetHashCode()).Next(availableBackends.Count) ];

				} catch (Exception ex) {
					// Grab existing single-element error array (created in inbound)
					var errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", null);
					  if (errArr != null) {
						errArr.Clear();
						var msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message";
						if (msg.Length > 300) {
							msg = msg.Substring(0, 300) + "...";
						}
						errArr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "code", "backendIndex-update" },
							{ "message", msg },
							{ "utc", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o") }
						});
					}

					return -1;
				}


			}" />
			<set-variable name="shouldLimit" value="@{
				try {
				// Check if the backend should limit concurrency
				JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				int backendIndex = (int)context.Variables["backendIndex"];
				if (backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) { return "off"; }
				JObject backend = (JObject)backends[backendIndex];
				return backend.Value("limitConcurrency");
				} catch (Exception ex) {
					var errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", null);
					if (errArr != null) {
						errArr.Clear();
						var msg = ex.Message ?? "Exception has no Message";
						if (msg.Length > 300) { msg = msg.Substring(0,300) + "..."; }
						errArr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "code", "shouldLimit-update" },
							{ "message", msg },
							{ "utc", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o") }
						});
					}
					return "off";
				}
			}" />
			
			<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
				var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
				var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				var priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray());
				bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contextWindowExceeded", false);
				int unthrottledCount = 0;
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					if (contextWindowExceeded && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") {
						continue;
					}
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) {
						unthrottledCount++;
					}
				}
				var remainingRetries = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount");
				var retryState = remainingRetries == 0 ? "exhausted" : remainingRetries.ToString();
				// Cycle Status
				arr.Add(new JObject {
					{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3")},
					{ "message", "RETRIES LEFT: " + retryState + 
								" CYCLE: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter") + 
								//" INDEX: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex") +
								" Unthrottled Backends: " + unthrottledCount }
				});
				return arr;
			}" />

			
			
			
				<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", 0) > -1 && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount") > 0)">
					
					<set-variable name="RetryCount" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount") - 1)" />
					
					<set-variable name="RequestTimeout" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("timeout"))" />
					<set-variable name="backendUrl" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("url"))" />
					<set-variable name="auth" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("auth"))" />
					<set-variable name="backendCallCounter" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter") + 1)" />
					
					
					
					
						<when condition="@(string.Equals(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("auth", ""), "MI", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))">
							
								@("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["managed-id-access-token"])
							
						
						<when condition="@(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("auth", "")))">
							
								@((string)context.Variables["auth"])
							
						
						
							
						
					
					<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
						// Backend Selected
						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						int index = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", 0);
						JObject backend = (JObject)((JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"])[index];
						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
							{ "message", "Using " + backend.Value("label") + " URL: " + backend.Value("url") +
								" LIMIT: " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") }
						});
						return arr;
					}" />
					

					
					
					
					
					
						<when condition="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackend"]).Value("bufferResponse"))">
							
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "low")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "medium")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "high")">
									
										
									
								
								
									
									
								
							
						
						
							
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "low")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "medium")">
									
										
									
								
								<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("shouldLimit", "off") == "high")">
									
										
									
								
								
									
									
								
							
						
					
					
					

					
					
					
					<set-variable name="isPermError" value="@{
						var isTempError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isTempError", false);
						var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500;
						bool isPermError =  !isTempError && (statusCode > 400 && statusCode < 500);
						return isPermError;
					}" />
					<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
						// Response Classified
						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode.ToString() ?? "N/A";
						var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
						var isTempError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isTempError", false);
						var statusSummary = isTempError ? "Temp Error" : (isPermError ? "Perm Error" : "Success");
						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
							{ "message", "StatusCode: " + statusCode + " - " + statusSummary }
						});
						return arr;
					}" />
				
				
					
					<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
						// No Backend
						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						var priorityBackendIndxs = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PriBackendIndxs", new JArray());
						int retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount", 0);
						string message;

						if (priorityBackendIndxs.Count == 0) {
							message = "NO BACKENDS: none configured for priority " + context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequestPriority", 3);
						} else if (retryCount <= 0) {
							message = "NO BACKENDS: retries exhausted";
						} else {
							var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
							bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contextWindowExceeded", false);
							var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
							var throttled = new List();
							foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
								JObject b = (JObject)backends[i];
								if (contextWindowExceeded && b.Value("label") == "PTU") { continue; }
								if (!b.Value("isThrottling")) { continue; }
								var retryAfter = b.Value("retryAfter");
								var secs = retryAfter > now ? (int)Math.Ceiling((retryAfter - now).TotalSeconds) : 0;
								throttled.Add(b.Value("label") + " - " + string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", secs / 60, secs % 60));
							}
							message = "NO BACKENDS: all throttled (" + (throttled.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", throttled) : "none") + ")";
						}

						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
							{ "message", message }
						});
						return arr;
					}" />
				
			
			
			<set-variable name="contextWindowExceeded" value="@{
				if (context.Response == null) { return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contextWindowExceeded", false); }
				
				int statusCode = context.Response.StatusCode;
				
				if (statusCode == 400) {
					try {
						var body = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
						var errorCode = body["error"]?["code"]?.ToString();
						
						if (errorCode == "context_length_exceeded") {
							return true;
						}
					} catch { }
				}
				
				// Keep existing value if not a context window error
				return context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contextWindowExceeded", false);
			}" />

			
				<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isTempError", true) || 
					(!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", true) && 
						(new[] { 429, 408, 400 }.Contains(context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0) || 
						(context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0) >= 500)))">
					
					<set-variable name="listBackends" value="@{
						JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
						int currentBackendIndex = (int)context.Variables["backendIndex"];

						// Validate backend index
						if (currentBackendIndex < 0 || currentBackendIndex >= backends.Count) {
							return backends; // Return unchanged if index is invalid
						}

						JObject backend = (JObject)backends[currentBackendIndex];

						// Attempt to retrieve retry-after duration from headers
						string[] retryHeaders = new[] { "retry-after" };
						int retryAfterSeconds = backend["defaultRetryAfter"].Value(); 

						foreach (string headerName in retryHeaders) {

							if (context.Response.Headers.Keys.Any(k => string.Equals(k, headerName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))){
								string headerValue = context.Response.Headers[headerName].FirstOrDefault();

								if (int.TryParse(headerValue, out int parsedValue) && parsedValue > 0)
								{
									retryAfterSeconds = parsedValue + 2;
									break;
								}
							}
						}

						// Update backend status
						backend["isThrottling"] = true;

						// we're multi-processing, so we need to set the retryAfter to the max of the current and the new one
						var newRetryAfter = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(retryAfterSeconds);
						if (newRetryAfter > backend["retryAfter"].Value()) {
							backend["retryAfter"] = newRetryAfter;
						}

						var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
						var effectiveRetryAfter = backend["retryAfter"].Value();
						var remainingSeconds = effectiveRetryAfter > DateTime.UtcNow
							? (int)Math.Ceiling((effectiveRetryAfter - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalSeconds)
							: 0;
						var retryAfterText = string.Format("{0:00}:{1:00}", remainingSeconds / 60, remainingSeconds % 60);
						// Backend Throttled
						arr.Add(new JObject {
							{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
							{ "message", "THROTTLED: " + backend.Value("label") + " Retry-After: " + retryAfterText }
						});

						return backends;	 
					}" />
					
				
			
			<set-variable name="unThrottledBackends" value="@{
				var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
				var priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
				bool contextWindowExceeded = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("contextWindowExceeded", false);
				int count=0;
				foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
					JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
					// Skip PTU backends if context window exceeded
					if (contextWindowExceeded && backend.Value("label") == "PTU") {
						continue;
					}
					if (!backend.Value("isThrottling")) {
						count++;
					}
				}
				return count;
			}" />
			<set-variable name="ShouldRetry" value="@{
				var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
				var retryCount = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RetryCount", -1);
				var unthrottled = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("unThrottledBackends", 0);
				var RequeueAllowed = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequeueAllowed", true);
				var proxyRequeue = RequeueAllowed && (unthrottled == 0);

				// retryCount has already been decremented for the attempt just made.
				return (!isPermError && retryCount > 0) && !proxyRequeue;
			}" />

			<set-variable name="ShouldRequeue" value="@{
				var isPermError = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", false);
				var ShouldRetry = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ShouldRetry", true);
				var RequeueAllowed = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("RequeueAllowed", true);

				return !isPermError && RequeueAllowed && !ShouldRetry;
			}" />

			<set-variable name="activityLog" value="@{
				// Retry Decision
				var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
				var ShouldRequeue = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ShouldRequeue", true);
				var count = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("unThrottledBackends", 0);
				var callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", false);
				var status = (context.Response != null && context.Response.StatusCode == 200);

				if ( callCompleted && status ) {
					arr.Add(new JObject {{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },{ "message", "CALL SUCCESSFUL" }});
				} else if (ShouldRequeue) {
					string message;
					var backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
					var priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
					message = "REQUEUE: true BACKENDS:";
					foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
						JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
						var remainingSeconds = backend.Value("isThrottling") && backend.Value("retryAfter") > DateTime.UtcNow
							? (backend.Value("retryAfter") - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalSeconds
							: 0;
						message += " [" + i + "]=" + backend.Value("label") +
							" Throttling=" + backend.Value("isThrottling") +
							" RetryAfter=" + remainingSeconds.ToString("F1") + "s";
					}
					arr.Add(new JObject {
						{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
						{ "message", message }
					});
				} else {
					arr.Add(new JObject {
						{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
						{ "message", "CALL INCOMPLETE, Unthrottled Backends: " + count }
					});
				}
				return arr;
			}" />

			
			
				
				<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", false) && context.Response != null && context.Response.StatusCode == 200)">
					
						
							
							
						
						
							
							
							
						
						
							
						
					
				

				
				<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ShouldRequeue", true))">
					
					<set-variable name="sleepDuration" value="@{

						JArray backends = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("listBackends", new JArray());
						JArray priorityBackendIndxs = (JArray)context.Variables["PriBackendIndxs"];
						DateTime minRetryTime  = DateTime.MaxValue;

						foreach (int i in priorityBackendIndxs) {
							if (backends[i].Value("isThrottling") && backends[i].Value("retryAfter") < minRetryTime) {
								minRetryTime = backends[i].Value("retryAfter");
							}
						}

						if (minRetryTime > DateTime.UtcNow)  {
							return (int)Math.Min(120000,  (minRetryTime - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalMilliseconds);
						}

						return 1000;
					}" />

					
					
						
						
							@{
								JArray errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", new JArray());
								return errArr.Count == 0 ? "" : errArr.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
							}
						
						
							true
						
						
							@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("sleepDuration",10000).ToString())
						
						
							@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendCallCounter", 0).ToString())
						
						
							@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter", 0).ToString())

								string dbgStr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("DbgStr", "");
								JArray actLog = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
								string result = string.Join(" | ", actLog.Select(entry => 
									((JObject)entry).Value("Elapsed") + "s " + ((JObject)entry).Value("message")
								));
								result = string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbgStr) ? result : dbgStr + " | " + result;
								return result.Length > 4000 ? result.Substring(0, 4000) + "..." : result;
							}
						
					
				

				
				<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("isPermError", true))">

							@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("PolicyCycleCounter", 0).ToString())
						
						
							@{
								string dbgStr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("DbgStr", "");
								JArray actLog = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
								string result = string.Join(" | ", actLog.Select(entry => 
									((JObject)entry).Value("Elapsed") + "s " + ((JObject)entry).Value("message")
								));
								result = string.IsNullOrEmpty(dbgStr) ? result : dbgStr + " | " + result;
								return result.Length > 4000 ? result.Substring(0, 4000) + "..." : result;
							}

policies.on-error:
<set-variable name="responseObject" value="@{
			var responseObj = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("responseObject", new JObject());
			var arr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
			var statusCode = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 500;
			var callCompleted = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("callCompleted", false);
			var backendIndex = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("backendIndex", -1);

			bool isTempError = statusCode == 429 || statusCode == 408 || statusCode == 400 || statusCode >= 500;
			bool isPermError = false;//!isTempError && (statusCode > 400 && statusCode < 500);

			if (callCompleted) {
				if (isPermError) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = statusCode;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Permanent Error";
				} else if (isTempError) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = statusCode;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Temporary Error";
				} else {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 500;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Unknown Error";
				}
			} else {
				JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];

				if ( backendIndex < 0 || backendIndex >= backends.Count) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 500;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Invalid Backend Index";
					return responseObj;
				}

				// recalculate timeout or concurrency limit because retry did not happen
				var wasLimited = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("wasLimited", false);
				var startTime = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("CallAttemptStartTime", DateTime.UtcNow);
				var deltaSeconds = (DateTime.UtcNow - startTime).TotalSeconds;
				var requestTimeout = ((JObject)backends[backendIndex]).Value("timeout");
				bool likelyTimeout = deltaSeconds >= (requestTimeout * 0.9);

				if ( likelyTimeout) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 408;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Timeout";
					statusCode = 408;
				} else if ( wasLimited ) {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 429;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Concurrency Limit";
					statusCode = 429;
				} else {
					responseObj["statusCode"] = 500;
					responseObj["statusReason"] = "Unknown Error";
				}
			}

			// Error Handler
			arr.Add(new JObject {
				{ "Elapsed", context.Elapsed.TotalSeconds.ToString("F3") },
				{ "message", "ON ERROR HANDLER INVOKED-  callCompleted: " + callCompleted +
					" isPermError: " + isPermError +
					" isTempError: " + isTempError +
					" StatusCode: " + statusCode }
			});
			return responseObj;
		}" />
		<set-status code="@(((JObject)context.Variables["responseObject"]).Value("statusCode"))"
			reason="@(((JObject)context.Variables["responseObject"]).Value("statusReason"))" />
		
		@{
			var responseObj = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("responseObject", new JObject());
			return responseObj.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
		}
		
			@{
				JArray actLog = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("activityLog", new JArray());
				string result = string.Join(" | ", actLog.Select(entry => 
					((JObject)entry).Value("Elapsed") + "s " + ((JObject)entry).Value("message")
				));
				return result.Length > 4000 ? result.Substring(0, 4000) + "..." : result;
			}
		
		
			@{
				JArray errArr = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("lastPolicyError", new JArray());
				return errArr.Count == 0 ? "" : errArr.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
